capabilities: Apply drag-and-drop gravity and bounce physics
React to vault events with confetti and waves
Run a customizable Pomodoro focus timer
extras: Retro sound effects are off by default; December mode activates automatically in December or can be toggled Always On. Manual install requires building with npm and placing robot.svg in src/.
problem: Obsidian's workspace is purely utilitarian, with no playful or animated element to make it feel lively.
summary: Sidebar robot companion that reacts to your cursor and vault activity, with drag-and-drop physics, a Pomodoro timer, and seasonal modes.
